people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Thus, sinning against the brothers, and wounding their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ.
translations.bsb: By sinning against your brothers in this way and wounding their weak conscience, you sin against Christ.
translations.kjv: But when ye sin so against the brethren, and wound their weak conscience, ye sin against Christ.
translations.asv: And thus, sinning against the brethren, and wounding their conscience when it is weak, ye sin against Christ.
